rules.description: Hot-path core code must use static top-of-file imports, not dynamic await import() of node builtins — dynamic import throws inside the packaged .exe and silently drops OmniLoop to the legacy loop.
rules.fix: Replace the dynamic `await import("node:...")` with a static `import ... from "node:..."` at the top of the file. Dynamic builtin imports work under `node` from source but FAIL in the pkg exe.

rules.description: git commands must not use the literal 'format:' prefix — the shell policy blocks the word 'format'.
rules.fix: Use a --pretty value that starts with % (e.g. --pretty=%h%x09%s) instead of --pretty=format:... — the shell safety policy blocks the word 'format'.
